svg.aria-label: Now building: Indic speech-to-speech model, iTantra (SIH 2026), open Hinglish datasets, KAUTILYA on every surface
svg.title: Now building: Indic speech-to-speech model, iTantra (SIH 2026), open Hinglish datasets, KAUTILYA on every surface

g.text: One model that listens and replies in every Indian
language, trained on a corpus I’m curating myself.
Indian-language speech recognition and synthesis that
carry voice over low-bitrate radio links, on-device.
Cleaning and packaging the Hinglish and Indic data
behind KAUTILYA so the community can train on it too.
Taking the Hinglish LLM from the browser to the terminal
to your pocket: agentic CLI, Go client, Android app.
